note: Twig Debugger is a single-checkbox module. Its settings form (route twig_debugger.settings at /admin/config/development/twig-debugger, permission 'administer twig debugger configuration') stores one flag, twig_debugger.settings:enabled. Saving with the box on also writes sites/default/services.yml (twig.config debug:true, auto_reload:true, cache:false) and clears caches; off deletes that file. The config object does NOT exist until the form is first saved. To keep the SHARED site stable, every medium/hard case here is grounded ONLY in the module's persistent Drupal config flag (twig_debugger.settings:enabled) and never touches services.yml. Scripts use the config factory directly, matching the module's own ConfigFormBase behaviour for the flag.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal contrib module twig_debugger. Where in the admin UI do I turn Twig debugging on, and what permission gates that page?
evals.expected_output: Go to Configuration > Development > Twig Debugger (/admin/config/development/twig-debugger, route twig_debugger.settings), tick 'Enable Twig Debugging' and save. The page requires the 'administer twig debugger configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: When I enable twig_debugger, which file does it change and what does it set in it to make Drupal show template debug comments?
evals.expected_output: Saving with the box on writes sites/default/services.yml (copied from default.services.yml if absent) and sets the twig.config block to debug: true, auto_reload: true, cache: false, then flushes caches. Disabling deletes sites/default/services.yml.

evals.prompt: In the twig_debugger module, what is the config object and key that records whether Twig debugging is turned on, and what does an unset value mean?
evals.expected_output: The flag is twig_debugger.settings:enabled (1 = on). The config object does not exist until the settings form is first saved, so a missing/NULL value means it has never been enabled (off).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, has Twig debugging been turned on through the twig_debugger module? Inspect the live configuration and state the value of the module's enabled flag.
evals.expected_output: Yes - twig_debugger.settings:enabled is 1 (Twig debugging is enabled) in the live config.

evals.prompt: A colleague thinks Twig debugging is on for this site via the twig_debugger module. Check the module's live configuration and report whether its enabled flag is on or off.
evals.expected_output: It is off - twig_debugger.settings:enabled is 0 in the live config, so Twig debugging is disabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the twig_debugger module to turn Twig debugging on: set the module's enabled configuration flag to on and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: twig_debugger.settings:enabled is set to 1 in the live config (e.g. via the settings form or \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('twig_debugger.settings')->set('enabled', 1)->save()).

evals.prompt: Twig debugging is currently enabled on this site via twig_debugger. Turn it off by setting the module's enabled configuration flag to off, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: twig_debugger.settings:enabled is set to 0 (or the config removed) in the live config so Twig debugging is off.
